text: Three families sued the Montgomery County Board of Education and schools Superintendent Monifa McKnight over pride storybooks that included Jodie Patterson's Born Ready: The True Story of a Boy Named Penelope. The families claimed the books were age inappropriate and inconsistent with their religious beliefs and child-rearing philosophies. A Laytonsville Elementary parent asked for their child to be excused from lessons featuring the book.
